_note: Octave-band shape: A-weighted band level minus A-weighted total L_WA, dB. Only the shape matters; band levels are renormalised so that their energy sum equals the turbine's L_WA. Replace with the manufacturer's spectrum for the turbine and operating mode being assessed.

mw_class_mean._source: derived - arithmetic mean of 10 normalised octave spectra of >=2 MW turbines listed in WINDFARMperception Final Report (van den Berg et al., 2008) Appendix B, appendix page 8 (PDF page 84), renormalised to sum 0 dB; cross-checked visually against Møller & Pedersen (2011), J. Acoust. Soc. Am. 129(6), Fig. 14 (agreement about 1 dB). Generic class average, not a specific turbine.
